description: Rename a rule, enable or disable it, or replace its keyword list. Turning a rule off, or a new list that leaves out keywords the rule has now, stops it catching what it caught, so that needs confirming: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview and a confirm_token, and repeating the call with the token makes the change. Renaming, turning a rule on, and adding keywords happen at once.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

keywords.description: Replaces the keyword list on keyword rules.

name: update_automod_rule
title: Update AutoMod rule
